# Intro stack

`studio/intro-stack` · intro · v1.0.0

Logo and wordmark, uppercase kicker, display title and an accent rule drawn from the centre, staggered in on the theme background (the reference intro).

![Intro stack preview — editorial theme, at 2.8 s](preview.png)

*Preview: the editorial theme, 2.8 s into the component; the manifest's preview samples.*

## Slots

| slot | type | default from | max chars | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` (required) | text | scenario.title.text | 60 | The video title. |
| `kicker` | text | scenario.title.kicker | 40 | Small uppercase line above the title. |
| `logo` | image | theme.logo |  | Logo image (the theme logo by default). |

## Params

| param | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | `center` \| `left` | center | Alignment of the column. |
| `rule` | boolean | true | Draw the accent rule under the title. |
| `stagger` | number (0–0.5) | 0.15 | Seconds between the kicker and the title entrances (the rule starts drawing 0.2 s after the title). |

- duration 3.2 s (1.5–8 s)
- variants: landscape, vertical
- theme tokens: `colors.accent`, `colors.text`, `background`, `fonts.display`, `fonts.body`, `logo`, `wordmark`, `style_bias`

Regenerate the preview and this block with `retake components preview studio/intro-stack`.
